asr.full_text: Yeah, tech support. I'm having a problem with my S'Mell brand computer. I need a bit of help here. This fucker is acting up like a trouble child on crack. Hello, what seems to be the trouble? Well, it seems in my tinkering, I went in to the DOS programming and changed a one to a zero. Now it won't even start up. What do I do, oh guru of computer wisdom? Have you tried restarting your computer? Yes, and it doesn't restart. Is your computer plugged in? That is very much common mistake. Wha- what kind of fucking stupid question is that? Yes, it's't restart. Is your computer plugged in? That is very much common mistake... What... What kinda fucking stupid question is that? YES It's plugged in! Don't. jerk me around! This fucking operating system is as unstable as Charles Manson And I need help! Is your monitor on? Another mistake. Dumbass. It doesn't. start. up! What is your operating system? The system that you are operating?! It's one of the Windows operating systems, you know. Very good. Do you like the icecream? What? Do you like icecream? What the? HELP ME! STOP ASKING DUMB QUESTIONS AND TELL ME WHAT TO DO! Hello? HELLO!? That will help you. Here's what you do... You hold down the following keys W F The number TWO The space bar what's happening out Ganesha is great And tapping on the escape key for 20 minutes So how was the weather there? Ah jeez, here we go Fine It is hot there, like a cow on fire Oh yeah? Where are you? Florida or California? I'm in India. India? wait, do you mean, like, Indiana? No! India. Wait a second! You're in India? I just said that! What the fuck? Why am I talking to someone in India about my computer that was made in Japan and bought in America? The smell computer company has moved their tech support headquarters to India cuz it did cheaper. Nice! Great! Well, why the fuck am I paying for first rate tech support from a third-world country? Not your slave wages. Pay attention. Focus! Oh, very sorry. How is your computer today? Broken, jackass. Broken. Wait, can I ask you a question? What if I just boot the computer up through the installer disk and have it rewrite the file I messed with? Yes, I guess you could do that. Oh, yeah, great. You've been a big fucking help. Thank you for using Smell Computer Tech Support. Please tell your friends. Damn foreign outsourcing. Keep the jobs in the US so I can understand who I'm talking to. You fucking bastards.
